question: How many paid days off do I get when an immediate family member dies?
queries: How many paid days off do I get when an immediate family member dies?
bereavement leave death of an immediate family member paid days

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Bereavement leave
results.text: Employees may take up to 5 paid days for the death of an immediate family member and up to 2 paid days for other relatives.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Annual paid leave
results.text: Full-time employees earn 20 days of paid leave per calendar year, accrued at 1.67 days per month.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Parental leave
results.text: The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. The secondary caregiver receives 6 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Parental leave must start within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Sick days
results.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year, separate from annual paid leave. Unused sick days do not carry over.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Requesting leave
results.text: Requests for 3 or more days of leave must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance.
